name: Rift-Stalker Menagerie
identity: The universal proxy faction: wasteland mercenaries, outcasts and tamed beasts. Any of the 29 universal archetypes is a legal Rift-Stalker datasheet; these 20 are the named core. Before the battle you sign 2 of 5 Mercenary Contracts.

rules.name: Mercenary Contracts (pick 2 of 5)
rules.description: Bounty Hunters: mark 2 enemy units; re-roll Hit and Wound rolls of 1 against them; +1 CP when one is destroyed · Guerrilla Infiltrators: 2 units gain [INFILTRATORS] and [SCOUTS 6″]; your units count as in Cover against attacks from more than 15″ · Shock & Awe: melee weapons gain [CRASHING], ranged weapons gain [ASSAULT] · Scavenged Grit: UNYIELDING 6+; Class 4–5 units heal 1 MIGHT at the End of Round · Master Tacticians: +1 CP in the Command Phase of Rounds 1 and 3. Any universal archetype (catalogue/unit_archetypes.json) is a legal datasheet at its catalogue price.

rules.name: Gamble — Objective Wager
rules.description: Before deployment, secretly note one no-man's-land objective. Reveal at the end of Round 4: if you control it, +3 VP; if your opponent does, they score +2 VP. (Risk: objective.)

detachments.name: Free Company
detachments.playstyle: Balanced mercenaries: take the contracts that fit the mission.

enhancements.name: Veteran's Contract
enhancements.description: **Wasteland Warboss** only. The attached unit has UNYIELDING 6+.

enhancements.name: Hazard Pay
enhancements.description: **Veteran Free-Blades** only. Re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: Covering Fire
stratagems.turn: A friendly unit within 6″ is charged
stratagems.effect: This unit makes a ranged Retaliation Strike against the charger.

stratagems.name: Pay the Bonus
stratagems.turn: A unit destroys an enemy unit

detachments.name: Outcast Scavengers
detachments.playstyle: Salvage crews that strip wrecks and objectives.

rules.name: Salvage
rules.description: When a Class 3–5 unit (either side) is destroyed, place a Salvage marker; a unit that ends a move on it gains +1 PEN on one weapon for the rest of the battle (remove the marker).

enhancements.name: Scrap-Plate
enhancements.description: **Line Mercenaries** only. +1 ARM (to 3+ cap) against PEN 0 and −1.

stratagems.name: Strip It Bare
stratagems.turn: A unit ends on a Salvage marker

stratagems.name: Makeshift Barricade
stratagems.effect: It claims Cover until the End of Round.

stratagems.name: Scav-Rush
stratagems.turn: A unit moves toward a Salvage marker

detachments.name: Monster Hunters
detachments.playstyle: Specialists who bring down big things.

rules.name: Big Game
rules.description: Re-roll Wound rolls of 1 against Class 3–5 units; Fell the Colossus Tactical card scores +1 VP.

enhancements.name: Harpoon-Gun
enhancements.description: **Bounty Hunter** only. +1 PEN with ranged weapons; [HARPOON].

enhancements.name: Monster-Slayer Charm
enhancements.description: **Hired Duelist** only. +1 Damage on a round he charged.

stratagems.name: Bait the Beast
stratagems.turn: An enemy Class 3–5 unit declares a Charge
stratagems.effect: The target may make a 3″ move first.

stratagems.name: Hamstring
stratagems.effect: It suffers −2″ MOV until the End of Round.
